image.comp: a quiet wooden sanctuary glowing with warm amber paper lanterns floating in cool mountain mist, an altar brass censer smoking softly
image.setting: quiet sanctuary hall on a misty hill above Hollowmere, warm paper lanterns

shrineIntro.arrival: Every other deed in Hollowmere smelled of salt, tallow, and cheap ink. This one smells of rain on warm cedar—and the unmistakable weight of {goddess}'s breath against the back of your neck as stone steps materialize beneath your boots.
shrineIntro.text: Cycle {cycle} waits in silence inside {house}. Unlike your first night in this world, the timbers don't feel borrowed from a stranger. Every beam hums faintly with what your hands have already built and unbuilt across Hollowmere's long nights, waiting to see who you invite back inside.
shrineIntro.res: The brass wick catches in deep amber, pushing back the mountain chill. Somewhere down the hill, Hollowmere wakes up to meet you again.

image.comp: standing serenely beside an unlit shrine pillar in soft ivory robes, pale gold eyes watchful and quiet, holding out one bare hand
image.setting: dim cedar shrine hall lit by a single warm paper lantern

vesselIntro.arrival: She doesn't knock on the front door like Marguerite Vane, nor tumble into your path down a market lane. She is simply standing beside the inner pillar when the first lantern flares—as if she has been waiting for the light to give her edges.
vesselIntro.text: No past name, no contract, no old debt clings to {name}. Her eyes follow your hand across the sill with quiet, unblinking stillness—unformed and endlessly attentive, like clay still warm from the kiln. Whatever habits, whims, or hunger this cycle wakes in her will be learned straight from you.
vesselIntro.res: Her cool fingers close gently over yours—an anchor before the town even wakes. She tilts her head once, filing away the warmth of your palm.

image.comp: wiping a polished mahogany bar counter by warm gilded lantern light, dark braided hair with silver at the temples, calm assessing smile
image.setting: warm cozy parlor bar of the Gilded Lantern Inn in Old Town at dusk, amber lamps

lantern.arrival: Red paper lanterns sway gently under the eaves of {house}, spilling amber across the cobbles of {loc}. Inside, polished brass winks back at two moons through leaded glass while the low hum of an empty common room settles around your shoulders.
lantern.greet:
{name} stands behind the long mahogany counter with a folded towel over one wrist and twelve years of steady patience in her posture. She looks you up and down once—hoodie, scuffed boots, bewildered stance—and pours a small glass of spiced cider before you even ask.

"You're the new owner, then," she says, sliding it across the wood. "Everyone calls me {first}. Keep the accounts honest and don't mistreat the staff, Sam, and you'll find I run a very clean house."
ngpp: Halfway through drying a glass, {first} pauses and frowns down at the wood. "Have I poured you cider at this counter before? Funny—for half a heartbeat I already knew how you take it."
{first}'s eyes narrow softly as she sets the towel down beside your elbow without checking where it is. "Don't laugh, Sam, but I walked in here knowing which stair board squeaks before you did."

{first} doesn't even pretend to be surprised when you cross the threshold. She slides the cider right to your preferred spot. "Welcome back, Sam. Don't ask me how I know which chair you like—just sit."

choices.label: Clink glasses and promise to look after the place
choices.res: {first} lets out a quiet breath she didn't realize she was holding. "Good answer, Sam. Follow me—I'll show you which locks stick."

choices.label: Ask her to walk you through the ledgers right away
choices.res: "Practical. I like that." {first} pulls the heavy house book from beneath the counter with a crisp slap.

image.comp: standing tall at the foot of a grand stone staircase holding a silver tea service, immaculate maid uniform, serene cool composure
image.setting: high stone foyer of Castle Rosenhal, moonlight through tall arched windows

castle.arrival: Twin moonlight spills silver across the flagstones of {house}, turning vaulted arches and faded tapestries into something out of a painting. Every chandelier sits dusted despite decades of fallen nobles.
castle.greet:
{name} awaits precisely three paces from the threshold, gloved hands folded over a silver pocket watch. Her curtsy is measured to the millimeter.

"Welcome to {house}, Mr. Takahashi," she says evenly, pale blue eyes missing neither the mud on your heels nor the way your jaw drops at the ceiling. "Tea is served at nine-fifteen, the east wing remains draughty, and I do not intend to watch another master run this estate into ruin."
ngpp: {first} checks her pocket watch and stops mid-breath. "Strange. I found myself brewing your preferred tea before I knew your name."
She sets the silver tray down right where your hand drops, then stares at her own wrist in quiet bewilderment. "Have you worn that jacket here before, Mr. Takahashi?"
{first} folds her watch shut before you even reach the stair, faint rose touching her cheekbones. "Tea is already poured, Sam. Forgive the liberty—I simply knew you'd ask."

choices.label: "I'm counting on you, {first}. Show me how this place runs."
choices.res: Her chin lifts a fraction, pleased in spite of strict training. "Very well. We begin with the west wing."

choices.label: Admire how spotless she kept the halls
choices.res: "Standards are what separate a castle from a ruin," {first} replies crisply, though the corner of her mouth softens.

image.comp: kneeling on warm cedar decking beside a steaming outdoor hot spring in a loose yukata, dark hair pinned with a comb, playful grin
image.setting: lantern-lit cedar bathhouse veranda overlooking misty pines and hot mineral water

onsen.arrival: Cedar steam curls past paper lanterns along the mountain ridge as {house} welcomes you with the low rush of mineral water and pine smoke. For the first time since the truck horn, your shoulders actually drop.
onsen.greet:
{name} lounges bare-ankled on the edge of the steaming deck, swishing a wooden ladle through the spring before tossing a folded towel straight toward your chest.

"Oh, good—you don't look stiff like a noble," she grins, leaning back on both palms as silk slips lightly off one shoulder. "I'm {first}. Don't overcomplicate the spring rules, treat the girls right, and maybe let someone scrub your back before you burn out, Sam."
ngpp: {first} blinks through rising steam, ladle hovering midair. "Wait. You look like you've soaked in that far corner before."
She slides smoothly toward the exact bench you always take, then tilts her head laughing softly. "Funny—I swore I knew your footsteps on the cedar."
{first} pats the warm stone beside her before you even kick off your boots. "Come on, Sam. The water's the exact temperature you like—don't ask me how I knew."

choices.label: Take her up on that tour of the springs
choices.res: "That's the spirit," {first} laughs, rising barefoot in a rustle of yukata silk.

choices.label: Tell her you'll make {house} worth every copper
choices.res: "Ooh, ambitious." Her eyes glint warmly in the mist. "Hold that promise, Sam."

image.comp: floating gently beside an arched manor mirror, translucent pale violet silk, mischievous grin, soft spectral glow
image.setting: dim candlelit foyer of Hollowmere Manor with dusty velvet drapes and grand mirrors

hollow.arrival: Iron gates creak open of their own accord beneath two moons, revealing {house} wrapped in silver ivy and blue-gold candlelight. The floorboards groan cheerfully when you step inside, as if the house itself waited for company.
hollow.greet:
Before you set down the deed, the candelabra flare violet—and {name} drifts straight down through the oak chandelier to hover nose-to-nose with you, chin propped lazily on one cool palm.

"Finally, someone living with a pulse and terrible taste in jackets," she purrs, circling slowly around your shoulders. "I'm {first}. Three hundred years in the rafters, so try not to be boring, darling."
ngpp: Cold fingers brush your collar and freeze mid-air. "Curious... why did your heartbeat feel so terribly familiar just then?"
{first} hovers sideways in front of the hall mirror, eyes narrowing playfully. "Tell me, Sam—have I haunted you in another dream?"

She drops right to floor height and loops both translucent arms loosely behind your neck. "I can't remember a thing past the veil, yet my name rolled right off your tongue in my head. Don't waste me this time, darling."

choices.label: "Ghost or not, let's bring this manor back to life."
choices.res: "Oh, I like you already," {first} beams, spinning a lazy loop overhead as dust settles in gold motes.

choices.label: Match her grin and ask which rooms aren't drafty
choices.res: "Only the best ones, naturally. Come see what the living miss."

image.comp: leaning both elbows on a heavy oak tavern bar, braided chestnut hair, broad warm grin and a frothy tankard held out
image.setting: boisterous dockside tavern common room with oak barrels, brass lamps, and salt-stained timber

tankard.arrival: Salt air, roasted malt, and laughter roll down the dockside steps before you even touch the heavy brass handle of {house}. Lantern light warms thick oak tables scarred by a hundred ship crews.
tankard.greet:
A frothy pint slams onto the counter in front of you before the door finishes swinging. Behind the taps, {name} wipes malt foam off her forearm and grins wide enough to rattle the glassware.

"New deed holder!" she booms fondly, squinting at your build. "Thought you'd be taller, lad—no offense. Drink up, keep the taps cold, and don't try watering my ale if you value your kneecaps."
ngpp: {first} pours your mug without asking light or dark, then scratches behind one ear. "Huh. Must've guessed lucky."
She leans across the bar eyeing your grip on the tankard handle. "Funny—I swore you've helped me tap that corner cask before."
"Welcome home, Sam," {first} blurts out—then blinks at herself and laughs hard, sloshing foam over the oak. "Don't ask why that slipped out, just drink!"

choices.label: Drink the pint down and praise the brew
choices.res: "Ha! Now there's an owner with proper taste!" {first} slams a friendly fist on the bar.

choices.label: "Point me to the cellar ledgers, {first}."
choices.res: "Right to business, eh? Come on down—the good barrels are waiting."

image.comp: poised gracefully beneath drifting paper lanterns in sheer sapphire silks, silver-blonde hair, calm luminous gaze
image.setting: open-air garden pavilion with lotus pools, silk curtains, and floating paper lanterns

pavilion.arrival: Wind chimes answer quietly as silk curtains part onto {house}, where paper lanterns reflect across still lotus pools in the Elven Quarter. Music hangs softly in the warm evening air.
pavilion.greet:
{name} steps barefoot off the low cedar stage, silk scarves trailing lazily from her wrists like mist over water. She inclines her head with unhurried grace.

"A human standing beneath the moonlilies," she murmurs, amber-gold eyes studying your face in gentle curiosity. "You bring loud air into a quiet garden, Sam—yet somehow it suits you. Protect the art beneath this roof, and the Pavilion will shine for you."
ngpp: Mid-curtsy, {first}'s silk ribbon slips toward your fingers as if on cue. "How strange... my steps already knew your rhythm."
She watches you step around the lotus basin without splashing a drop. "Few humans know where those flagstones dip. Why do you walk here so easily?"
{first} meets your eyes without hesitation, a warm hush behind her grace. "I cannot recall the first dance we shared, Sam—yet my pulse remembered you at the gate."

choices.label: "Promise I'll let the dancers shine here."
choices.res: "Then the lilies will bloom all season," {first} smiles gently, tucking a ribbon behind her ear.

choices.label: Stand quietly with her by the lotus pool
choices.res: She exhales a quiet breath, pleased by a new owner who knows when not to rush.

image.comp: lounging across velvet bar cushions beneath ruby lamps, obsidian horns and swishing tail, slow sly smirk
image.setting: sultry crimson-lit Underdistrict salon with velvet drapes and brass braziers

veil.arrival: Ruby lantern glow spills up cobbled stairs as {house} hums beneath the Underdistrict arches—incense, spiced plum wine, and low laughter drifting behind velvet curtains.
veil.greet:
{name} is coiled comfortably over the corner banquette, tail tapping a lazy beat against carved blackwood while embers catch the curve of her horns.

"Well, well—fresh blood holding a crisp new deed," she purrs, gesturing you closer with two ringed fingers. "Try not to faint at the rules down here, Sam. We keep sharp teeth, sharper drinks, and soft sheets for anyone bold enough to keep up."
ngpp: {first}'s tail stops mid-flick as you step into the red light. "Hmm. Don't look at me like that unless you plan on reminding me where we've met."
She slides two wine glasses across the lacquer without asking which vintage you prefer. "Weird. You don't flinch at the smoke the way first-timers do."

{first} unfolds lazily off the velvet and steps straight inside your personal space, grinning sharp. "No idea how you slipped into my head, darling—only that every lock in the Veil feels made for your key."

choices.label: Accept the ruby glass and grin right back
choices.res: "Oh, you might actually survive the Underdistrict," {first} laughs softly, clinking glass to yours.

choices.label: "Keep the floor sharp—I'll handle the house debts."
choices.res: "Music to a demoness's ears, handsome. Come see the back suites."

image.comp: holding a brass taper beside velvet-draped pews, pale golden halo glowing softly over dark curls, serene teasing smile
image.setting: candlelit sanctuary cloister with stained glass, incense smoke, and crimson velvet

sanctuary.arrival: Warm beeswax and sweet myrrh float past carved arches into the night courtyard of {house}, where stained-glass lanterns cast amber and crimson roses across polished stone.
sanctuary.greet:
{name} stands beside the velvet-curtained confessional, brass taper gleaming softly beneath the warm arc of her halo. When she turns, her smile is half saintly mercy and half sinful invitation.

"Peace be upon the new keeper of {house}," she murmurs, stepping closer until incense clings to your collar. "I'm {first}. Around here, absolution comes warm, unhurried, and strictly behind closed curtains—whenever you care to learn the liturgy, Sam."
ngpp: {first}'s halo flickers warmer as you clear your throat at the threshold. "Curious... the bells didn't even ring, yet my pulse knew someone dear walked in."
She touches your knuckles lightly with candle-warm fingers and freezes for a beat. "Forgive me—for one breath I felt as though you'd knelt at my altar a dozen nights already."
"Welcome back to sanctuary, Sam," {first} whispers before catching herself with a surprised, delighted blush. "Let's not question why the candles burned brighter the moment you came in."

choices.label: "Teach me how this cloister keeps peace."
choices.res: "With pleasure—and far fewer robes than the High Cathedral prefers," {first} purrs.

choices.label: Offer her a warm hand by the altar steps
choices.res: Her halo brightens in gentle amber as she squeezes your fingers cleanly.

image.comp: adjusting a brass pressure gauge with slender articulated fingers, pale cyan eyes gleaming in warm steam and lamp glow
image.setting: ornate brass-and-mahogany clockwork salon with humming acoustic pipes and velvet divans

atelier.arrival: Ticking brass escapements and soft harp-like resonance greet you inside {house}, where copper steam conduits curl cleanly behind plush sapphire velvet suites.
atelier.greet:
{name} straightens beside a softly glowing regulator, wiping fine machine oil from delicate porcelain-pale knuckles with a silk handkerchief. Her cyan optics focus smoothly on your face.

"Ownership transfer verified: Takahashi, Sam," she chimes in a warm, measured cadence. "Chassis designation {name}. Every acoustic vent, heated divan, and ledger tally inside this atelier is ready for your inspection."
ngpp: A soft click sounds inside her chest housing as she registers your voice. "Odd calibration variance: pulse resonance matches an archived baseline with zero prior log."
{first} tilts her head, pale cyan eyes softening at the edges. "My thermal sensors already expect your grip on that handrail, Sam. How perplexing."
"Welcome home, Sam," {first} murmurs, pressing two fingertips cleanly to her collar where an old memory buzzes warmly. "My logs read empty—yet every gear in my frame remembers your name."

choices.label: "Call me Sam—and let's run this house together."
choices.res: Soft rose warms her cheek plates. "Parameters updated gladly, Sam."

choices.label: Inspect the humming brass suites with her
choices.res: {first} glides proudly ahead, explaining every valve and acoustic cushion in precise detail.

image.comp: setting down a basket of warm butter rolls at an oak reception desk, warm amber eyes and rolled sleeves, cheerful smile
image.setting: busy crossroads coaching inn foyer with hearth fire, oak beams, and travel trunks

wayfarer.arrival: Crackling hearth fire, roasting chestnuts, and the rattle of iron carriage wheels greet you outside {house}, perched right where three trade roads knit Hollowmere together.
wayfarer.greet:
{name} wipes flour off both forearms against her apron and trots around the reception desk to grip your hand like a long-lost cousin.

"Thank the moons—an owner who doesn't look scared of a broom!" she grins brightly, nodding toward the warm kitchen steam drifting out back. "I'm {first}. Keep clean sheets on the upstairs beds and warm tea for tired drivers, Sam, and this crossroads will pay for itself thrice over."
ngpp: {first} sets out a fresh cinnamon roll before you even look at the tray, then laughs puzzled. "Wait—didn't even ask if you liked those yet!"
She hands you the spare brass key off the hook without fumbling once. "Funny how fast you settle into a doorway, Sam. Like you've walked off that porch a hundred mornings."
"About time you got back, Sam!" {first} blurs out mid-hug before pausing, wide-eyed and smiling anyway. "Dunno where that came from—must've dreamed you up last winter."

choices.label: Grab a warm roll and pitch in with the ledger
choices.res: "Now you're talking!" {first} beams, sliding the guest book right under your elbow.

choices.label: Promise the crossroads will stay safe under your watch
choices.res: She nods warmly, visibly relieved to have steady hands beside the hearth.

image.comp: leaning casually against a skyship rail above drifting clouds, brass goggles pushed into tousled wind-whipped hair, cocky grin
image.setting: cliffside tavern built around a moored airship deck overlooking dusk clouds and brass rigging

skyhook.arrival: Wind tugs straight at your jacket as plank walkways carry you over the cliff edge into {house}—half tavern, half grounded airship leaning proudly over the sea of clouds below Hollowmere.
skyhook.greet:
{name} vaults clean off the taffrail with brass goggles perched in her wind-tousled hair and one boot thumping squarely onto a rum cask.

"Welcome aboard, cap'n-on-paper!" she crows, tossing you a corked bottle of spiced cloud-rum. "Don't touch the main rigging without asking, don't flinch at the drop, and keep the tavern busy enough to pay for tar and canvas!"
ngpp: {first} catches herself tossing you the exact spare grip-rope off the rail without glancing up. "Whoa—must've mistaken your stride for an old mate's."
She squints into the sunset breeze with a half-grin that softens unexpectedly. "You stand on a pitching deck like you've ridden storms with me before, Sam."
{first} drops down right in front of you and bumps her shoulder solidly against yours. "No logs, no charts—yet every rope on this ship knows your boots, Sam. Ready to fly this tavern again?"

choices.label: Pop the cork and toast the view
choices.res: "Ha! That's my new landlord!" {first} cheers above the cliff wind.

choices.label: Ask about the moored hull behind the bar
choices.res: Her grin turns proud and wistful at once. "Someday, Sam, I'll show you she still has wings."

image.comp: wading calf-deep in glowing tide pools inside a cavern grotto, pearlescent scales along her collarbone, cool enigmatic gaze
image.setting: sea-carved luminous grotto bathhouse lit by glowing pearls and rippling azure pools

pearl.arrival: Gentle surf echoes through vaulted sea-stone as {house} opens onto warm mineral tide pools lit by clusters of luminous cavern pearls floating softly over the water.
pearl.greet:
{name} rises smoothly from the shallow turquoise shelf, cool droplets sliding cleanly off iridescent shoulders as she drapes a white silk wrap around her waist.

"You smell of smoke and cobblestones, land-dweller," she murmurs, pale sea-glass eyes weighing your stillness. "I am {first}. Respect the tides beneath these stones, Sam, and the Grotto will warm every guest you send down."
ngpp: {first} pauses waist-deep in the tide pool as a ripple brushes her wrist. "Strange... even the deeper pool settled the moment your shadow fell over the stone."
She sets a pearl lantern cleanly along your path without glancing back. "You do not hurry beside the water, Sam. Like someone who has listened to it with me already."
"So the tide brought you back to the steps," {first} whispers, sea-glass eyes surprisingly gentle beneath the pearl glow. "The water remembers every footstep even when my mind wakes empty."

choices.label: "The Grotto is in good hands, {first}."
choices.res: A rare, quiet smile curves her lips as warm pearl light deepens across the pool.

choices.label: Walk the tide ledges slowly beside her
choices.res: She paces cleanly beside you, nodding when you avoid the slick wet limestone.

image.comp: resting a heavy iron smithing hammer across one broad shoulder beside glowing timber rafters, soot smudge and hearty grin
image.setting: massive timber-and-iron bath-and-hall house in Foundry Row with glowing hearth embers

foundry.arrival: Heat from iron hearths and the crisp smell of oiled oak welcome you into {house}, where towering beams brace a rough-and-ready pleasure hall built for dockworkers, smiths, and mercenaries with coin to burn.
foundry.greet:
{name} hefts a cedar plank with one arm, wipes sweat and soot cleanly off her brow, and flashes a grin tough enough to crack anvil iron.

"Alright, boss—or should I say landlord?" she chuckles, extending a calloused hand that squeezes like a blacksmith's vise. "Half the west wing still leaks when it storms, so roll up your sleeves if you expect {house} to print gold!"
ngpp: {first} tosses a spare work apron straight into your chest without looking. "Huh—knew your arm span off the cuff, apparently."
She leans on her hammer eyeing how you inspect the cracked west truss. "Funny, Sam—could've sworn you helped me brace that exact beam once."

"Welcome back to the iron hall, Sam!" {first} grins wide, clapping your shoulder hard enough to sting. "Couldn't tell you why that felt like greeting an old partner—only that we're finishing the rafters this time."

choices.label: "Show me the weak beams—let's fix her up."
choices.res: "Ha! Hands that aren't scared of splinters!" {first} leads you straight toward the gallery stairs.

choices.label: Promise steady timber funds and better ale
choices.res: "Say less, Sam. You keep the coin flowing and I'll build you a fortress."

image.comp: tending dark crimson night-blooming orchids under vaulted glass, sleek fox ears perked curiously, velvet collar and warm smile
image.setting: lush moonlit glasshouse conservatory filled with hanging brass censers and exotic flowers

conservatory.arrival: Warm jasmine, lotus resin, and damp loam wrap around you under the curved glass dome of {house}, where twin moons turn mist and orchid petals to silver lace.
conservatory.greet:
{name} glides between velvet chaise lounges with a brass watering can and four sleek tails swaying neatly behind her skirts, amber eyes crinkling warmly.

"Mind the hanging censers, darling," she murmurs, hooking two light fingers gently inside your collar to straighten your hoodie. "I'm {first}. Every scent beneath this glass coaxes secrets loose—let's see what blooms once you settle in, Sam."
ngpp: {first}'s ears twitch sharply as she blends a censer bowl—then pauses staring at the exact cedar-and-spice note she just added. "Curious... why did I reach for that jar on instinct?"
She lets her fox tail brush slowly across your wrist while pouring tea. "You smell oddly like dusk beneath glass, Sam. Like an evening I only almost remember."
"There you are, darling," {first} sighs softly, leaning lightly into your arm before blinking in amused surprise. "Forgive me—my hands remembered your shoulders faster than my head caught up."

choices.label: "Teach me what these blooms can do."
choices.res: "Oh, gladly," {first} purrs, drawing you toward the warmest bench beneath the dome.

choices.label: Breathe in the warm air and compliment her house
choices.res: Her fox ears perk high with delight. "Wait until midnight, Sam—the best buds haven't opened yet."

image.comp: adjusting rimless spectacles beside gilded parlor mirrors and velvet drapes, sleek ebony bun, poised knowing half-smile
image.setting: gilded high-society salon hall with marble stairs, velvet sofas, and tall mirrors

lyceum.arrival: Tall gilded mirrors catch crystal chandelier light twice over as you cross the threshold of {house}—quiet, razor-sharp luxury carved right out of Hollowmere's upper avenue.
lyceum.greet:
{name} lowers a gilt-edged syllabus and peers over slim spectacles, reading your posture, collar, and calloused knuckles in a single sweeping glance.

"Punctual enough, Sam," she notes smoothly, closing the leather folio with a soft tap against her palm. "I am {first}. High society pays absurdly for flawless poise and forbidden discipline—maintain my standards, and every noble purse in the quarter will belong to us."
ngpp: {first} pours two plum wines without glancing down at the tray, then pauses at your glass. "Strange—I served you before asking whether you prefer sweet or dry."
She taps her spectacles thoughtfully as you hold the heavy salon door cleanly. "Your manners aren't clumsy like a newcomer's, Sam. Have we debated syllabus terms before?"
"Back for advanced tuition, Sam?" {first} murmurs with a sudden, razor-warm smile that surprises even her. "No memories on record—yet something tells me you never flinch in my classroom."

choices.label: "I'm a fast learner, Professor."
choices.res: Her poised eyebrow arches in genuine approval. "We shall test that thesis shortly, Sam."

choices.label: "Keep the academy sharp—I'll fund the velvet."
choices.res: {first} inclines her head neatly. "Then let us tour the upper practice salons."

image.comp: leaning against an alley lantern post fastening a dented leather bracer, bright red fox ears and bushy tail catching dusk light, cocky grin
image.setting: lantern-lit cobbled street outside an inn at dusk

kaede.arrival: When Marguerite Vane's carriage rattles out of sight, someone vaults cleanly down off the courtyard wall beside you—boots landing without a sound, bright red fox tail flicking dust off her travel cloak.
kaede.greet:
{first} taps a notched training blade over one shoulder and sizes up the crooked inn sign with a sharp grin.

"Alright, Sam—this place looks half-held together by string and prayers, and I've got zero intention of watching an unarmed guy from another world get mugged on night one. You handle the books and the talking; I'll keep drunks off the stairs."

choices.label: "Glad to have someone watching my back, {first}."
choices.res: Her fox ears flick upright and she bumps her shoulder smartly into yours. "Just don't walk into dark alleys alone and we'll get along great."

choices.label: "Try not to scare off paying customers on week one."
choices.res: {first} laughs sharply, leaning her sword against the doorframe. "No promises—only the rowdy ones!"

image.comp: draped languidly against a lantern post at dusk, violet eyes gleaming, sleek bat wings tucked neatly and pointed tail curling
image.setting: dim cobbled alleyway lit by warm amber streetlamps

nerys.arrival: Shadow curls warmly off the porch stone before any footstep sounds, smelling faintly of sulfur and night-blooming spice. By the time you blink, {name} is leaning beside the lantern post like she owns the lease on your pulse.
nerys.greet:
One dark-nailed finger hooks gently under your chin, tilting your face toward the amber lamp glow while her slit pupils narrow in wicked delight.

"Freshly summoned, bruised knees, already drowning in debt..." {first} purrs softly against your ear. "What an irresistible little bargain, Sam. Keep me fed, keep me entertained, and let's see how quickly this boring town melts."

choices.label: "Just don't burn the inn down for fun."
choices.res: {first} laughs low in her throat, tail tip brushing your wrist. "No fun unless you're watching, darling."

choices.label: "Welcome to {house}, {first}. Let's make coin."
choices.res: "Practical devilry. I adore that in a mortal."

image.comp: standing serenely beside wooden inn steps carrying a woven basket of fragrant dried herbs, long pointed ears, gentle green eyes
image.setting: quiet courtyard steps at twilight beside glowing herbs and wooden lanterns

elowen.arrival: While your head still rings from twin moons and Marguerite Vane's ink, a cool hand smelling cleanly of crushed chamomile and cedar presses a small ceramic cup into yours.
elowen.greet:
{name} steps smoothly onto the porch beside you, woven herb basket resting over one slender forearm, long elven ears tilting softly toward your breathing.

"Drink slowly, Sam," she murmurs in a cadence smooth as river water over stone. "Your pulse is still racing from the crossing. Let me tend the bruises inside these walls—some wounds here require medicine, and others simply need gentle hands."

choices.label: Drink the warm tea and thank her
choices.res: Some of the ache behind your eyes eases at once. {first} offers a rare, soft smile. "We will take this one evening at a time."

choices.label: "You really know how to steady a rough landing."
choices.res: "I have had long practice waiting on lost travelers," {first} replies quietly.

image.comp: standing straight-spined beside the inn doorway in tarnished half-plate and crimson cloak, blonde braid, resolute grey eyes
image.setting: cobbled inn doorstep under twilight lanterns

adelheid.arrival: Boot heels click precisely across the paving stones behind you, accompanied by the clean oil-and-steel chime of real armor worn by someone who hasn't taken a true rest in weeks.
adelheid.greet:
{name} sets one gauntleted hand firmly over the pommel of her longsword and inclines her head in crisp knightly salute.

"You have stepped into perilous footing with very little steel to your name, Sam Takahashi," she says evenly, grey eyes scanning the street before returning to your face. "A pleasure house may not be a noble garrison, yet honor follows conduct, not stone. Keep your word beneath this roof, and my blade guards your threshold."

choices.label: "Call me Sam—and thank you for standing with me."
choices.res: Her shoulders ease a fraction, steel discipline softening into quiet warmth. "Very well... Sam."

choices.label: "With you at the door, nobody's pushing us around."
choices.res: "On my oath," {first} answers crisply, stepping inside to inspect the locks.

image.comp: perched on a wooden trunk at the doorway flipping through a crumpled ledger, gold hoop earrings catching lantern glow, spirited smirk
image.setting: warm inn entryway lit by hanging amber lanterns

marisol.arrival: Before Vane's carriage clears the corner, a slim woman with brass ink-stains on her thumb and gleaming gold hoops has already plucked the spare deed copy straight off the table.
marisol.greet:
{name} whistles low through her teeth at the debt column, then drops onto the ledger stool and crosses one boot neatly over the other.

"Well, Sam—if you plan on surviving Vane Credit House, you're going to need someone who can actually count fast without weeping over spilled wine," she grins sharply, tapping your chest with the rolled parchment. "Half this quarter owes my family ghosts anyway. Split the work fair with me, and we'll make every creditor choke."

choices.label: "Deal—partners on the numbers."
choices.res: Her dark curls bounce as she snaps the ledger shut. "That's what I wanted to hear, partner!"

choices.label: "Show me where the previous owner buried his mistakes."
choices.res: "Pull up a chair, Sam. Grab tea—it's a long list."

image.comp: standing shyly under an arched wooden porch holding an old ribbon-tied bundle of letters against her chest, long elf ears flushing faintly
image.setting: lantern-lit wooden porch beside an old post lantern at dusk

lirael.arrival: Quiet footsteps pause just inside the doorway light—not a stranger's stride, yet carrying ten years of ink, postage wax, and late-night margins you never imagined had a face.
lirael.greet:
{name} clutches a worn, ribbon-tied bundle of letters tight against her wool coat, pale pointed ears trembling faintly in the evening chill as she checks your face against a hundred imagined sketches.

"You're... taller than your handwriting made you sound," she whispers softly, eyes shining beneath the porch lamp. "Wait—Sam. It really is you on this side of the postbox. I left the sorting office the hour my last envelope came back warm."

choices.label: "You actually came looking for me, {first}..."
choices.res: Her shoulders drop in shaky, radiant relief. "I promised I'd write until someone answered—even across worlds."

choices.label: Offer her a warm chair out of the night chill
choices.res: {first} tucks the old letters neatly inside her coat and steps beside you into the lamp glow.

image.comp: standing motionless beneath a glowing streetlamp with folded white-feathered wings and faint golden halo, calm searching amber eyes
image.setting: quiet cobbled lane beneath softly flaring street lanterns at dusk

anael.arrival: Every streetlamp along the block flares bright gold without wind or flint—and beneath the closest awning stands a winged sentinel watching you with quiet, unearthly stillness.
anael.greet:
{name} folds snow-white feathers neatly behind her shoulders as her halo dims down to a warm candle ring so she doesn't draw stares from the street.

"Sam Takahashi," she says softly, voice clear as struck crystal. "Every lantern within the Quiet Lamp blazed the instant your soul crossed the threshold. I was sent to observe whether you spell ruin for Hollowmere—so do try not to embarrass either of us while I take notes."

choices.label: "Stick around then, {first}—judge for yourself."
choices.res: A quiet crease softens the corner of her mouth. "I fully intend to, Sam."

choices.label: Hold the door open out of the night air
choices.res: "Thank you," {first} murmurs, folding one wing carefully past the timber frame.

image.comp: standing slightly hunched in a crisp cardigan and pencil skirt clutching a black red-swingline stapler like armor, flushed tearful eyes lighting up
image.setting: lantern-lit parlor foyer at twilight, mismatched modern office supplies resting on an oak counter

yui.arrival: Amidst brass oil lamps and parchment ledgers, a sleek black stapler sits glaringly out of place beside an inkwell. A small, familiar gasp catches in the doorway right behind you.
yui.greet:
{name} freezes mid-step, dark hair falling slightly over one flushed cheek as she stares at your grey hoodie like she's seeing a ghost walk out of the fourth-floor elevator back in Tokyo.

"T-Takahashi-kun...?" her voice cracks completely before rushing forward to grab your sleeve with both cold hands. "Wait—that's really you! No overtime bell, no last train, and my stapler came across with me! Don't let go for a second, Sam—tell me I'm not dreaming on my desk!"

choices.label: Grip her hands firmly and tell her you're both really here
choices.res: {first} lets out a wet, breathless laugh and presses her forehead briefly against your sleeve. "Okay... okay. At least I don't have to face another weird world alone."

choices.label: Point out her red stapler already sits on the counter
choices.res: She blinks at it, bursts out giggling through her tears, and straightens her skirt with sudden fierce resolve.

image.comp: leaning lazily in the tavern doorway resting a worn wooden-wrapped katana scabbard on one hip, dark hair in a loose ponytail, fierce relieved grin
image.setting: dusk courtyard arch lit by warm wooden lanterns

natsuki.arrival: Steel rings softly inside an oiled scabbard out in the yard—and then a voice you grew up scraping knees beside cuts straight through three years of impossible distance.
natsuki.greet:
{name} drops cleanly off the low garden wall, worn guild cloak dusted with highway mud, eyes narrowing sharply until recognition slams straight through her chest.

"No way," she breathes—three years of lonely wandering falling off her shoulders in one heartbeat before she marches over and flicks your forehead hard. "Three years in this world, Sam! Three whole years swinging iron at monsters and sleeping in awful inns, and YOU wash up right down the street running a parlor?!"

choices.label: Rub your forehead and pull her into a tight hug
choices.res: {first} freezes half a second—then drops her hand onto your hoodie back, gripping tight. "Idiot," she mutters against your neck. "Glad you finally caught up."

choices.label: "Hey—someone had to keep the lights on for you, Natsuki."
choices.res: She snorts, wiping the corner of her eye with one scarred knuckle, grin wicked again. "Save me the soft bed upstairs, then."

image.comp: leaning casually against the doorway rail with one hip cocked, warm plum lipstick, silk kimono-robe shawl over modern dress, teasing fond smile
image.setting: lantern-lit bar porch at evening twilight

kanako.arrival: Warm jasmine perfume cuts neatly through Hollowmere woodsmoke—too crisp, too familiar, tasting exactly like late Fridays leaning over Apartment 3B's rusted balcony rail back home.
kanako.greet:
{name} taps a brass pipe lightly against her palm, looks from your bewildered face to Marguerite Vane's ridiculous ledger, and breaks into a slow, husky laugh that knocks half the tension straight out of your ribs.

"Well, look what the moons washed up—my little Sammy, all grown up and holding keys to a brothel!" she coos, smoothing down your rumpled collar with warm palms. "Relax, sweetheart. You kept me company on my worst nights back in Tokyo; turnabout's fair play."

choices.label: "{first}-san... thank goodness someone sane ended up here too."
choices.res: She laughs softly and pinches your cheek. "Sane is generous, Sammy—but I sure know how to pour a drink and run a room."

choices.label: Pour her a glass right behind the bar
choices.res: "Oh, you already remember how I take it," {first} purrs, sliding onto a stool with effortless poise.

image.comp: bursting through the doorway clutching a folded bright umbrella like a sword, oversized sweater sleeves, radiant teasing grin hiding damp eyes
image.setting: warm inn foyer lit by paper lanterns at dusk

akari.arrival: Quick sneakers—honest-to-God Earth sneakers, mud-flecked from a dirt road—skid across the threshold mats right before a brightly folded commuter umbrella pokes through the curtain.
akari.greet:
{name} halts halfway inside, cheeks rosy from running half the market street, and breaks into a radiant grin that wipes every ounce of medieval gloom right out of the hall.

"Surprise, Sam!!" she chirps brightly—then immediately drops the peppy act just enough to lunge straight into your ribs, hiding her face against your jacket. "Wait—don't tease me, I checked three towns looking for Kenta and found YOU first, and I don't care how weird this place is—I'm NOT letting you out of sight again!"

choices.label: Pat her back firmly and promise she stays safe here
choices.res: {first} sniffles once, laughs fiercely against your shirt, and pops back upright beaming. "Right! House rule one: no disappearing! Kenta would kill you!"

choices.label: "Did you actually bring an umbrella to a dry town, Akari?"
choices.res: "It was raining at the crosswalk!" she protests indignantly, hugging the umbrella strap tight with bright eyes.

image.comp: standing quietly beside the doorframe in a worn black coat and lace cuffs, pale anxious smile, dark eyes fixed softly on his hoodie
image.setting: dim lantern-lit inn stairwell at dusk

lara.arrival: Nobody heard the latch click, yet when you turn toward the hallway lamp, a familiar shabby black coat stands pressed shyly beside the coat pegs as if waiting permission to breathe the same air.
lara.greet:
{name}'s fingers twist slowly around the frayed hem of her sleeve, kohl-ringed eyes tracking the exact grey hoodie you wore on the back steps back home.

"Rumors crossed three towns about a strange boy wearing Alder Street's coat," she whispers softly, voice barely louder than the wick hiss. "I didn't believe it until I saw the way you lean on one foot when you're tired, Sam. Please don't send me back down the road tonight."

choices.label: "You're never stuck on the road again, {first}. Come inside."
choices.res: A long, shaky exhale breaks out of her chest as she steps quietly into the lamplight beside you.

choices.label: Hang her dusty coat up carefully beside yours
choices.res: {first} watches both coats hanging together on the peg, dark eyes softening with quiet wonder.

image.comp: hovering awkwardly in the parlor entrance clutching a thick clothbound notebook, fluffy grey wolf ears twitching nervously behind round glasses
image.setting: warm wooden inn lounge lit by glowing hearth embers

emily.arrival: Someone coughs softly near the parlor shelves—accompanied by the unmistakable rustle of graph paper and a fluffy tail thumping erratically against the doorframe.
emily.greet:
{name} pushes round glasses up her nose with ink-smudged fingers, grey wolf ears folding flat in sudden total panic before she blurts out your old forum handle like a prayer.

"Wait—okay, don't freak out about the ears, I didn't choose them—Sam?!" she squeaks, slamming both hands over her notebook as her tail wraps straight around her own calf. "Our Tuesday thread went 'last seen' six weeks ago and then I woke up here with teeth sharper than my pens!"

choices.label: "Shadowkin? Wait—you really brought your campaign notes?!"
choices.res: Her wolf ears snap straight upright like lightning rods! "You remembered! Half the lore literally came true in this place, Sam!"

choices.label: Pull up two mugs of cider and tell her to catch her breath
choices.res: {first} flops dramatically onto the hearth bench, tail wagging slowly behind her ankles.

image.comp: standing arms crossed by the parlor ledger desk in crisp tailored collar, sharp eyes assessing the numbers, neat notebook tucked under one elbow
image.setting: lamplit parlor study with tall ledger shelves at dusk

ella.arrival: Crisp heels cross the floorboards in a rhythm you'd recognize blindfolded from four years of department honors seminars and rival coffee runs back home.
ella.greet:
{name} sweeps one sharp glance over Marguerite Vane's interest schedule, pulls a mechanical pencil straight out of her blazer pocket—from another universe entirely—and taps the red subtotal twice.

"Honestly, Takahashi—even hit by a delivery truck, you still sign terrible initial contracts," she remarks dryly, though the tremor in her wrist gives away how hard she ran once she heard your last name in town. "Move over. If we're stuck in this absurd city, I'm not letting you lose to a loan shark on spreadsheets."

choices.label: "Glad you found me, {first}. Grab a chair—we've got work."
choices.res: Her poised mask cracks into a brief, fierce smile. "Naturally, Sam. Try to keep up."

choices.label: "Admit it—you were worried when you saw the street."
choices.res: Color flashes sharply across her cheekbones. "I'm merely protecting my benchmark, Sam. Now hand me that inkwell."

image.comp: standing calmly beneath two moons in the courtyard, silver-white hair catching starlight, faint warm gold node glowing at her temple, holding a leather diary
image.setting: quiet stone courtyard under twin moons and floating brass lanterns

ione.arrival: Night air hushes cleanly around the courtyard fountain—and a faint, melodic hum answers your pulse before your eyes catch silver hair shimmering beneath twin moons.
ione.greet:
{name} closes a worn leather diary marked with brass clasps and tilts her head at an exact, curious angle as the pale indicator beside her temple shifts from cyan to warm amber.

"Visual match confirmed: Sam Takahashi, cycle entrance," she speaks smoothly, stepping inside without disturbing a drop of dew. "My archive names this building, this hour, and your grey jacket—yet the pages after tonight are blank. May I stay and observe how you fill them?"

choices.label: "Let's write those blank pages together, {first}."
choices.res: Her amber node pulses twice in soft wonder. "Hypothesis noted happily, Sam."

choices.label: Offer her warm tea even if she doesn't need it
choices.res: She cups the porcelain gently between warm-skinned palms, studying the steam like scripture.
